race.description: Team Aidan Markets @ Crjc 22 November (Bm66) Hcp
race.comment: ALWAYS A RAINBOW (9) is the one to beat after coming back from Saturday company at Eagle Farm, where she was seventh behind Easy Love but still made some ground after beginning awkwardly. Her Doomben third two back reads well, she is proven at this venue, and her wet-track record gives her a clear platform on the heavy ground. HERALD ANGEL (4) brings the most consistent recent profile, having won a Class 2 at this track on soft ground after missing by a nose at Lismore, and her record around this distance is hard to fault. COSMIC COCO (11) earned respect by winning a BM58 at Ballina and beating DARK CHILL there, though the rise to BM66 asks more of him. DARK CHILL (10) was only just over two lengths behind COSMIC COCO last time and gets meaningful weight relief, with his distance record keeping him firmly in the mix.
